analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction and alleges ongoing financial loss (wages withdrawn by ex-partner from joint account) and material distress, and asks for the account to be frozen (CH-1).
analysis.summary: Customer visited branch about a joint account with her ex-partner [PERSON_1]. Since separation he withdraws her wages as soon as they arrive; she says he is controlling and she is scared of him. Withdrawals of £300-£600 each payday since August. She wants the joint account frozen and her own account set up. She asked not to be called or written to at home; a safe contact number is held. Statement Aug-Nov 2026 is on file.

timeline.event: Withdrawals of £300-£600 every payday begin, per branch note
Customer attended branch, reported ex-partner taking her wages, asked for joint account freeze and new own account, asked for no home contact
Branch colleague recorded safe contact number and joint account reference

analysis.severity_reason: Possible suspected financial abuse and customer at risk of harm (fear of ex-partner); estimated loss may exceed £1,000 over several paydays (CH-6 vulnerable customer at risk of harm).

vulnerability.suggested_support: Refer to Vulnerable Customer Support. Contact only via the safe number, never write to the home address. Record a named contact and adjustments. Safeguarding of her wages and a separate account need prompt action. Sensitively ask about support needs.

analysis.routing_reason: Indicators of controlling behaviour and suspected financial abuse, with fear for safety and financial difficulty, meet the VUL-4 referral criteria. The case is not clearly fraud or unauthorised, as the ex-partner is a joint holder, but Fraud & Scams may be considered by the specialist.

policy_citations.quote: Cases with a vulnerability indicator *and* any of: financial difficulty, risk to health or wellbeing, suspected financial abuse, or bereavement must be referred to the Vulnerable Customer Support team.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: Customer reports a controlling ex-partner taking her wages and says she is scared, indicating suspected financial abuse and risk to wellbeing.

policy_citations.quote: Reasonable adjustments must be offered and recorded, for example a preferred contact method, a named contact, more time to respond
policy_citations.how_it_applies: Customer asked for no calls or letters to home; safe number only.
